translations.text: O God, Who grantest forgiveness and desirest the salvation of mankind : we beseech Thee in Thy mercy to grant that Thy servants and handmaids who have passed out of this life, by the intercession of blessed Mary ever a Virgin and of all Thy saints, may partake of everlasting bliss. Through our Lord.
